reviews.x: The brushes are of medium quality--not too soft, but not too hard.  About what you'd expect for the price. Everyone is totally right about the smell when you open the package!  Very chemically!  Make sure to wash/soak your brushes in warm to hot water and soap before you use them--it will help get out the red dye that is on some of the brush heads--so it won't end up on your or your client's face!

I was really excited when I got all of these brushes for the price. Upon arrival, they were clean and soft, then I started using them. They, very quickly, became brittle and rough. The bristles fall out all the time and they are really hard to clean. I used a makeup brush shampoo to clean them and maybe make them softer, but the bristles became mangled and even more brittle. I only use a select few of them because the 12 eye shadow brushes are either really stiff and harsh or brittle and the hai

I BOUGHT THIS PRODUCT FOR SCHOOLS SO I JUST NEEDED A CHEAP BRUSH SET, I DIDNT EXPECT MAC OR SIGMA QUALITY BRUSHES, HOWEVER FROM THE OTHER REVIEW I DID EXPECT THEM TO BE A LITTLE BETTER QUALITY. THE BRUSHES AND BRUSH ROLL SMELL AWFUL WHEN YOU OPEN THE! I WASHED THEM RIGHT AWAY AND THE SHED A LOT... MORE THEN NORMAL BRUSHES. THE BRISTLES ARE FLIMSY. I WOULDNT PURCHASE THIS AGAIN

This product is not worth the money. This is a great gift for a young girl. Its fun with all the different brushes and a teenage girl would love this. But Im 30 and for everyday brushes, they're cheaply made. Bristles fell out the minute I removed the brush from the plastic wrap. The tips were uneven and just not what you would want out of everyday make up brushes.

I just received the package today. I was pretty excited at the beginning, but when I picked the first brush the little hairs started falling off. That happened with about 4 brushes. If that didn't happen, I would definitely give then a 5 star review, but I really hate it when the hair falls off and stays on my face.
These brushes are rough, the bristles fall out and they smell horrible!! Don't waste your money! These are nothing but junk!

I was hesitant to buy this set because of all the reviews of it being stinky. I'm glad that I did buy it! The smell is really not horrible, I don't know why people hate it that bad. The scent is that of a mechanic shop and leather jacket. You have to wash all make up brushes anyway so there is really no big deal. The paste brushes are sooo soft and I have not had any shedding! These are better than my Estee Lauder set (those frizzed and became brittle.) These are middle of the line quality, they

reviews.t: A Great Starter Set For Makeup Artists and Serious Makeup Mavens!
reviews.x: I've been buying individual brushes here and there for a long time (MAC brushes are my favorite splurge!) but this was the first time I decided to try out a set of brushes with a brush roll.  I'm definitely a convert!  I love the brush roll that comes with this set: it folds up nicely and keeps the brushes protected and safe.  The material is sturdy and is wearing well over the months that I've been using it.  It wipes down easily if you get makeup all over it.  The brushes themselves are nice a

I was looking for a good daily use brush set.  As I expected, the brushes are fairly cheaply made. The eyebrow/eyelash brush head popped off the first time I used it, but after a little super glue it hasn't been an issue.  They work well and are comfortable to use. I love the wonderful leather case they come in. I would recommend these brushes to anyone who wants a very broad range of brushes to use for quite a low price.

reviews.t: An okay set for the price
reviews.x: I currently recieved my brushes and must say that its worth the price. It does come with various brushes, some useless though. Don't expect to be getting top quality brushes when your paying such a low price. The brushes aren't a really good quality but for beginners I think it's worth it. The downside is the smell and the red dye that seeps though if you don't wash them. WASH YOUR BRUSHES THROUGHLY!!

These brushes might as well be for preschool watercoloring. When i got this set there were two brushes without hair in them. Then the "soft hair" is about as soft as sandpaper on your lids. I gave these to my three year old to play with and destroy bc they are useless as can be. "Professional quality" they are not. Do not waste your time or money unless youve got both to spare

These brushes are really tough.  Feels like a hair brush.  Very rough for putting makeup on someone's face.  Also feels like a number 2 pencil.  Someone got this for my birthday and I totally appreciate the gift but I do not even use these brushes :( which is sad because there are so many.  The foundation and concealer brush in this set work good.

Never have I had a set of brushes that lives up to the standards that these brushes do. I am a professional makeup artist and I have been spending hundreds upon hundreds of dollars on brushes from big names for years. These brushes are amazing and even if you don't like them as well as your MAC brushes, they are cheap and easy to replace. . ..

yea mixed feelings...some brushes r soft and some r stiff or not soft.....i got this for a friend cause she didnt want to create a amazon account to order stuff and her sister actually liked it so i ordered it for her sister too! well good thing is that u get lots of brushes for a cheap price right? brushes r so expensive!

reviews.t: You get what you pay for.
reviews.x: I got these brushes on sunday. And first of the chemical smell was really bad!!! I hate it. I washed them at least 3 times. The face brushes shed a bit. But other than that I'm happy. Eventually the chemical smell will die down or I'll get use to it, but this is great someone who want to become better at make-up, as I.

I can't review an item that never arrived - wasn't sure until yesterday which brand it was - talked to the person I gave the set to for Christmas and she confirmed that she got the Coastal Scents set ---I 'm sure this was on my statement - so I bought two with one missing in action -----Joan Blacker

I'm a beginner when it comes to make up and I find that the hair in the brushes seem to fall out while I am using them, causing them to get caught in my eyelashes or, worse, in my eyes. They work great other than that and the case is great for keeping them together. All around I like this product.

ive never owned any real brushes before, and i have to say thease are beautiful, they are soft and apear to be well made, the case has a nice stylish look to it.  only thing that would make it better would be if came with an insurt that explaind what each brush was and how to use it.

These came sooner than I had planned and were in perfect condition (being new).  The style of brushes were more than I imagined.  I now have brushes that don't loose their bristles nor break the heads off.  I love these brushes, I would recommend these to everyone!

I've needed make up brushes for a long time. I recently lost all my make up though, so I have not been able to use them yet. They are very soft, and only have minimal shedding (1-3 hairs on only some brushes) Definitely will buy again if I need brushes!

I bought these because I started experimenting with different tech for make up and when i got them with in a week the heads started coming off and i had to tape them ALL and the shed wayy too much id rather stick with my sigma brushes

These brushes are very nice, and easy to use. Just make sure to WASH the brushes first to get out all of the dye and chemical smell out of them. Other than that i enjoy using these brushes, since i got so many for such a cheap price.

reviews.t: Love it and will order a second one!
reviews.x: I was absolutely happy it arrived so fast i ordered it on sunday and tuesday it was already here i was playing around with them and i feel in love 32 brushes and they are amazing i recomend it you will love them

I love my brushes. The quality of the brushes is very good. They came on time and they get the job done. Blend very well for the price they cost me. Very cheap price for the amount of brushes it came with.

The brushes are a little rough but I seem to notice that when I use the super soft bristles they hang on to more makeup (less makeup on my face) and dont last as long also they do not shed their bristles.

claims.text: Many reviewers report a strong chemical smell when opening the package, though some say it fades after washing.
Bristles shedding or falling out is a frequently mentioned problem.
Several reviewers find the brushes rough, stiff, or harsh rather than soft.
Many consider the set good value for the low price, especially as a starter or beginner set.
Some reviewers praise the quality highly, with one professional makeup artist calling them amazing.
